svg.title: Republican-favored House rating calibration
svg.desc: For each of four raters, observed Democratic win rates in Lean R, Likely R, and Solid R seats are compared with conventional category probabilities. Each row reports its called-race sample size.
svg.text: Filled dot: observed Democratic win rate | Hollow dot: conventional probability
